title: Meta AI releases OPT-175B, a 175-billion-parameter language model, to the research community
summary: Meta says the model was trained on publicly available datasets and offered to researchers.

title: Clearview AI agrees in ACLU lawsuit settlement to restrict access to its face database, pending court approval
summary: CNN reports the settlement bars sales of the database to private individuals and businesses; CSET notes the 20-billion-image database access limits need judicial approval.

title: Georgetown Law report says US immigration agency accessed records of about 75% of US adults via data brokers
summary: The Georgetown Law Center on Privacy & Technology report says ICE spent nearly USD 570M from 2008 to 2021 on data analysis and facial-recognition contracts.
srcName: Georgetown Law Center on Privacy & Technology

title: Google unveils LaMDA 2 and the AI Test Kitchen app at its I/O keynote
summary: Google launched AI Test Kitchen, an Android app powered by LaMDA that generates suggestion lists for complex goals.

title: DeepMind introduces Gato, a 'generalist agent' that performs more than 600 tasks
summary: DeepMind's Gato handles tasks across several modalities with one model, according to CSET's newsletter.

title: CB Insights says global funding to AI startups fell 12% in Q1 2022 to just over USD 15bn
summary: The CB Insights 'State of AI Q1 2022' report, noted in CSET's May newsletter, compares Q1 with Q4 2021.

title: Inflection AI, co-founded by DeepMind and LinkedIn co-founders, raises USD 225M, CNBC reports
summary: CNBC reports the new AI lab raised USD 225 million.

title: US-EU Trade and Technology Council sets up AI group for a joint roadmap on trustworthy-AI measurement tools
summary: The second TTC meeting in France produced a joint statement on 16 May creating the group to evaluate and measure trustworthy AI and risk management.

title: Wired: Cruise robotaxis lose communications fleet-wide and are immobilized
summary: Wired reports that Cruise vehicles lost communications across the fleet on 18 May and stopped.

title: Google introduces Imagen text-to-image model but withholds code and public demo, citing misuse risk
summary: Google's Imagen page says it will not release it for public use without further safeguards and notes bias from uncurated web data and weak results on images of people.

title: UK data regulator issues enforcement and penalty notices to Clearview AI over UK residents' images
summary: The Verge reports the Information Commissioner's Office ordered Clearview to delete UK residents' data and imposed a fine.

title: Oak Ridge's Frontier is announced as the world's first exascale supercomputer
summary: Oak Ridge National Laboratory announced Frontier on 30 May, and the TOP500 list ranks it first at 1.1 exaflops.
